reasons.claim: The notification is a 3.61 ha polygon (3 ha notified) regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning) in Nyköping, status 'notified'. No completed felling overlaps it (0%), so this is not ALREADY_FELLED.

No eligible species within 250 m. The only red-listed record there is Polygala vulgaris (NT, 218 m, 2024), which the tool flags as not forest-associated and not felling-relevant, so it is not eligible.

One eligible species lies just beyond 250 m: Sarcosoma globosum (EN fungus, 1 record, 301 m, 2016, unc 25 m). Its factors include lack of continuity forest, lack of large or old trees, and soil disturbance in forestry. This matches the rubric MEDIUM rule.

Effort within 1000 m is below the county median: 707 records against 724 (50th percentile), 124 species. Within 250 m there are 14 records on 4 days against a county median of 12, and none inside the polygon. Threatened species recorded within 1000 m at a below-median-effort site is an additional contradiction.

uncertainties: The only eligible record is from 2016 (about 10 years old) at 301 m, so the species may no longer be there. It was not found within 250 m.
Effort is just below the county median, so the lack of eligible records close by is only weakly informative.
The polygon's equivalent radius is 107 m. The record may not reflect conditions inside the stand.
not_established: Whether Sarcosoma globosum or any red-listed species occurs on the polygon.
Forest character or stand age: the tools do not state it.
Whether felling is legal or harmful.
Absence of species on or next to the site, including sensitive species hidden in public data.
next_action: A reviewer should check the 2016 Sarcosoma globosum record (GBIF link in E-22318) against the polygon and its habitat. Consider a field check, since inventory of the site is thin and the record is old.
